主要内容: On January 13, 2012, Core Laboratories N.V. announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.28 per share of common stock. The dividend was payable to shareholders of record on January 24, 2012, and the payment was scheduled for February 24, 2012. This announcement was made through a press release, which is included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. The information provided in the report and the attached exhibit is not considered "filed" under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, unless explicitly stated. The press release was issued by Core Laboratories N.V., a company based in the Netherlands, and the announcement reflects its financial and operational activities in the oil and gas services industry.
